title: Algebra characters of a Banach algebra decrease norms
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] with a real-valued multiplicative absolute value satisfying the triangle inequality. Let $A$ be a commutative unital $K$-algebra with a norm $\|\cdot\|:A\to\mathbf R_{\geq0}$ such that $\|a\|=0$ exactly when $a=0$, $\|-a\|=\|a\|$, $\|a+b\|\leq\|a\|+\|b\|$, $\|ab\|\leq\|a\|\|b\|$, $\|ca\|=|c|\|a\|$ for $c\in K$, and $\|1\|=1$. Assume $A$ is complete for the metric $\|a-b\|$. Then every unital $K$-algebra homomorphism $\chi:A\to K$ satisfies $|\chi(a)|\leq\|a\|$ for all $a\in A$. No continuity assumption on $\chi$ is imposed.

source.place: AlgHom.norm_apply_le_self, lines 434–436; hypotheses read at lines 409–410. CompleteSpace is required on A, not on K.
